alerts.guard: owner authentication + project_path resolved root containment; directory-only branch does not read JSON
alerts.reason: Разветвление проверено на old baseline: kind=directory,purpose=workflow исполняет только строку101(is_dir), возвращает state/path/directory и не достигает file branch104, stat111 или read_text114. Это coarse type/existence ответ для уже известного owner-controlled проектного пути, без перечисления содержимого, private document или outside-root доступа. Поэтому35 не prerequisite JSON chain34 и не подтверждён как самостоятельный arbitrary-path read. Общая privacy policy теперь всё равно блокирует private directory selection.

alerts.guard: NEW selected applies the shared private-root policy before file predicates, size check and JSON read

На old baseline kind=file,purpose=workflow исполняет строки104(is_file),111(stat) и114(read_text), после чего возвращает synthetic private document. stat size check сам по себе не раскрывает JSON и остаётся внутри root, но является достижимым шагом подтверждённой цепочки до чтения. Не dismiss отдельно от34 только из-за metadata-формы sink.

alerts.guard: NEW canonical namespace validation before trial and live writes; source-schema targets cannot be overwritten by sources/workflow payloads
alerts.reason: Подтверждённый элемент единой namespace/validation-bypass цепочки с40/41. Источники могут быть dual-use JSON Schema: со штатным sources_path invalid trust отвергается, но traversal в schemas/sources.schema.json перезаписывает cloned schema и baseline принимает те же данные. Reported38/39 относятся к topic mkdir/write, а schema poisoned соседним atomic_json; совместный topic+sources payload воспроизведён. Поэтому sandbox здесь не достаточен для FP: его результат разрешал последующую live запись. Это дубликаты одной цепочки, не отдельные функциональные баги.

confirmed_functional_findings.finding: topic/sources prefix checks accepted traversal to other project namespaces; sources payload could overwrite the cloned source schema and bypass strict trial validation
confirmed_functional_findings.fix: Canonical relative paths + resolved target checked against the exact allowed subtree/fixed file, rechecked under locks before commit

confirmed_functional_findings.finding: Workflow could replace an already validated app/sources/image_channels/holidays document after trial validation
confirmed_functional_findings.fix: Protected resolved targets cannot be workflow destinations; workflow is included in trial writes; validate and save use the same target policy

confirmed_functional_findings.finding: Direct files/select purpose=workflow read private browser/OpenCode/import JSON while browse hid these paths
confirmed_functional_findings.fix: selected checks browsable first; known opencode.private.json is forbidden; private-purpose metadata remains supported

confirmed_functional_findings.finding: Implicit default browser profile was missing from the private directory list
confirmed_functional_findings.fix: Shared privacy catalogue protects known default and configured browser/OpenCode roots, including after relocation; purpose=private still returns metadata only.

confirmed_functional_findings.finding: workflow=None could bypass workflow_path checking and arrange later settings reads from private paths, including browser/OpenCode state configured under config/
confirmed_functional_findings.fix: A shared pure private_roots(root, app, purpose) resolves configured browser/OpenCode/private-import roots. Workflow targets always reject these roots independently of their physical namespace; browse and selected reuse the same policy. snapshot rejects before read_text.

original_alert_6.note: The same advisory was still present for the explicit CI setuptools pin (alert 80), fixed by this change.

limits: CodeQL false positives are separate from confirmed bugs; dismissal does not weaken queries or branch rules.
Filesystem containment is not a claim of immunity to a privileged local writer racing path resolution.
Torch, model loading and real conversion were not run; translation checks cover the audited non-Torch dependency subset and offline imports.
This report contains no actual credentials, cookies or private runtime files; raw SARIF/advisories/logs stay in ignored local audit storage.
